name: Network / Environment
description: Connectivity or DNS failures caused by environment instability

name: Blocking Modal (RESTRICTED ZONE)
description: Unexpected modal dialog blocked interaction — typically the RESTRICTED ZONAL ZONE modal with I can't wait! button

name: Data / Content Availability
description: Expected content or data not available in the environment (e.g. D-BOX showtimes, seats, schema)
messageRegex: .*(?:No D-BOX films|No suitable seats found|No .* found on the cinema|No films found|No showtimes available|Unable to find a film|undefined|not contain 'undefined').*

name: Feature Removed / Unavailable
description: Feature or navigation target does not exist in the current environment (e.g. Bonos link in lab)

name: Test Timeouts
description: Full test exceeded its timeout budget (usually 90-180s). Severe blocker or infrastructure issue

name: UI: Interaction Timeouts
description: A specific Playwright action (click, waitFor, fill, waitForEvent) timed out waiting for an element or event

name: UI: Selectors / Strict Mode
description: Selector resolved to multiple elements (strict mode) or element detached from DOM
messageRegex: .*(?:strict mode violation|resolved to \d+ elements|detached from DOM).*

name: Infra / Browser
description: Browser, page, or context crashed or closed unexpectedly
messageRegex: .*(?:Target page, context or browser has been closed|Target closed|Context closed|browserType\.launch).*

name: Product Defects
description: Genuine assertion failures indicating a bug in the application under test
